obligations.required_partition: Both DOWNLOAD_TLS_MIN_VERSION=TLSv1.2 and DOWNLOAD_TLS_MAX_VERSION=TLSv1.3 are configured.
obligations.required_observable: The resulting SSLContext has minimum_version TLSv1.2 and maximum_version TLSv1.3.
obligations.counterexample: Either bound remains a library default or the two bounds are swapped.

obligations.required_partition: Both new TLS version settings are omitted.
obligations.required_observable: The context uses ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_CLIENT without assigning explicit minimum or maximum versions.
obligations.counterexample: Omitted bounds force a concrete TLS version or revive the deprecated method selector.

obligations.required_partition: Twisted context construction with both TLSv1.2 minimum and TLSv1.3 maximum.
obligations.required_observable: The factory stores TLSVersion.TLSv1_2 and TLSVersion.TLSv1_3 and translates them for CertificateOptions.
obligations.counterexample: The bounds are discarded, represented as strings, or applied to the wrong endpoints.

obligations.required_partition: A legacy non-default TLS method and at least one new version bound are configured together.
obligations.required_observable: The factory clears the legacy method and uses the explicit version range.
obligations.counterexample: The legacy method overrides or coexists ambiguously with the new bounds.

obligations.required_partition: DOWNLOAD_TLS_MIN_VERSION is set to an unknown value.
obligations.required_observable: A ValueError names DOWNLOAD_TLS_MIN_VERSION and includes the rejected value.
obligations.counterexample: The value is ignored or the diagnostic does not identify the minimum setting.

obligations.required_partition: DOWNLOAD_TLS_MAX_VERSION is set to an unknown value.
obligations.required_observable: A ValueError names DOWNLOAD_TLS_MAX_VERSION and includes the rejected value.
obligations.counterexample: The value is ignored or the diagnostic does not identify the maximum setting.

obligations.required_partition: A caller reads the historical METHOD_TLS export.
obligations.required_observable: The value is "TLS" and access emits ScrapyDeprecationWarning naming METHOD_TLS.
obligations.counterexample: The name disappears, changes value, or is returned silently.

obligations.required_partition: The legacy method setting is assigned TLSv1.2 instead of its TLS default.
obligations.required_observable: Factory construction emits ScrapyDeprecationWarning directing the caller to the new min/max settings while preserving the selected legacy method when no bound is present.
obligations.counterexample: The non-default setting is silent or no longer works during the compatibility window.

obligations.required_partition: Twisted 26.4.0 is active, TWISTED_TLS_LIMITS_OFFBY1 is false, and TLSv1.2 is requested as the maximum.
obligations.counterexample: The maximum mapping is missing, changed to another version, or treated as a lower endpoint.

obligations.required_partition: Twisted 26.4.0 is active, TWISTED_TLS_LIMITS_OFFBY1 is false, and TLSv1.3 is requested as the maximum.
obligations.required_observable: lowerMaximumSecurityTo receives TLSVersion.TLSv1_3 exactly and the helper returns normally.
obligations.counterexample: The maximum mapping is missing, changed to another version, or rejected as unrepresentable.

obligations.required_partition: A caller reads the historical openssl_methods export.
obligations.required_observable: The exact four-entry compatibility mapping is returned and access emits ScrapyDeprecationWarning naming openssl_methods.
obligations.counterexample: The name disappears, changes value, or is returned silently.
